projects.title: shapargullay
projects.description: An event ticketing platform for Pakistan. People find concerts, qawwali, comedy, theatre and workshops by city or category, pay by card and get their ticket instantly. Organisers list and sell their own events, and every listing is checked by a person before it goes on sale.
highlights: Events by city and category, from Lahore and Karachi to Multan and Peshawar
Card payments through Safepay, with the 4% service fee shown before you pay
Instant tickets with QR entry, emailed PDFs and Apple and Google Wallet passes
Ticket messages on WhatsApp, free transfers to friends and tools for organisers

projects.title: Mian Art Store
projects.description: An online shop for a stationery and art-supply store beside Islamia University. Artists, students and offices can browse paints, canvases, school and office supplies by category or by brand, and order for delivery anywhere in Pakistan.
highlights: Full catalogue by category and by brand, from Deer and UHU to Keep Smiling
Product variants, sale prices, deals and ready-made bundles
Search, wishlist, compare, quick view and customer accounts
Cash on delivery, with free delivery on orders over Rs. 3,000

projects.title: Barrientos Construction

highlights: Service pages for homeowners, landlords, investors and commercial clients
Free-estimate and callback forms with a service picker
Project gallery with filters, testimonials and a blog
Vendor registration and a language switcher

projects.title: FIXMYIMEI

Home page with a promotional slider, popular categories and best offers
Cart, checkout, customer accounts, wishlist and compare
Product pages that explain each service in plain terms
